column1: # Game profile of Cult of the Lamb 1.0.0 (Unity 2019.4.35f1 IL2CPP, FMOD, SDK 13.3.2, NVN).
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file.
# Virtual address memory: the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource and main never sets a heap (the heap check saw none), so a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias
# region, where the game maps its memory itself. The surveyed values held: its regions reach alias +3.79 GB in the first 15 s, and about 2.8 GB resident in play (README.md)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near=0), so its vertex shaders use the main0_z entries; the pipeline bases made before it runs (the Mac app's archive,
# the Mac prebuild) are made for that mode
# The game asks for present interval 2 (30 fps) but steps by Unity's frame time, as Monster Train 2 does: one frame per display tick plays at 60 fps at normal speed
